author: More Perfect Union
description:
At the G-7 summit, a global gathering of the world's most powerful countries, AI execs got to sit together with Presidents and Prime Ministers.

It's a disturbing symbol of how tech oligarchs are gaining power, and of how leaders are bending over backwards to accommodate them.

Producer: trevorp_hayes
Editor: Kunga Choephel
Supervising Producer: Court Fuller
title: Why are AI CEOs being treated like the Presidents of major countries?
